id: 07_How to test for peroxides using Quantofix dip strips
title: 过氧化物试纸检测（国内版）
source_doc: course/Laboratory Equipment Safety Series/07_How to test for peroxides using Quantofix dip strips.md
author_source: project/Laboratory Equipment Safety Series/07_How to test for peroxides using Quantofix dip strips（国内版）/src.py

points.K2: 在通风橱里，穿戴好防护
points.K3: 取试纸：够用就好，别碰测试区
points.K6: 测有机溶液，别漏加水步骤
points.S3: 可疑容器：不开、不动、先报告

shots.scene: 欣欣站在通风橱旁，手里举着一条空白试纸
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a fume hood holding up a blank white test strip and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 今天讲怎样用试纸检查过氧化物。

shots.scene: 阿杰从柜子深处拿出一瓶落灰的溶剂，标签空白
shots.prompt_en: The young male student pulls a dusty brown solvent bottle with a blank label from the back of a chemical cabinet.
shots.narration: 阿杰翻出一瓶放了很久的溶剂。

shots.scene: 小研抬手示意他停下，指向瓶上的空白日期栏
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student raises her hand to stop him and points at the blank date boxes on the bottle label.
shots.narration: 小研说：先别开，这种溶剂要先检查。

shots.scene: 试纸、溶剂瓶和放大镜三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a blank test strip, a brown solvent bottle and a magnifying glass. No people.
shots.narration: 用专用试纸，查溶液里有没有过氧化物。

shots.section_title: 在通风橱里，穿戴好防护
shots.scene: 小研站在通风橱前，穿实验服、戴护目镜和手套
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stands at a fume hood wearing a lab coat, safety goggles, gloves, long pants and closed shoes.
shots.narration: 检测在通风橱里做。
overlay: 在通风橱里，穿戴好防护

shots.section_title: 在通风橱里，穿戴好防护
shots.scene: 五个防护图标排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Five icons in a row: safety goggles, a lab coat, gloves, long pants and a closed shoe. No people.
shots.narration: 护目镜、实验服、手套、长裤、包脚鞋。

shots.section_title: 取试纸：够用就好，别碰测试区
shots.scene: 小研打开空白的试纸罐，取出一条试纸
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student opens a blank metal test strip canister and takes out a single strip.
shots.narration: 需要几条取几条，不要多拿。
overlay: 取试纸：够用就好，别碰测试区

shots.section_title: 取试纸：够用就好，别碰测试区
shots.scene: 试纸一端的测试区被圈出，手指图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: A close icon of a test strip with the test pad at one end circled, and a fingertip touching the pad crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 尽量别碰试纸上的测试区。

shots.section_title: 取试纸：够用就好，别碰测试区
shots.scene: 试纸罐盖子马上盖好
shots.prompt_en: A gloved hand immediately presses the lid back onto the blank test strip canister. No people.
shots.narration: 取完马上盖好试纸罐。

shots.scene: 废液瓶图标旁一条试纸，打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: A waste bottle icon with a blank label and a test strip beside it, with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 测废液，可以直接蘸取。

shots.scene: 试剂瓶倒出少量到小烧杯里，试纸伸进小烧杯
shots.prompt_en: A small amount of liquid poured from a reagent bottle into a small beaker, and a test strip dipped into the beaker. No people.
shots.narration: 不是废液，先倒少量到小杯里测。

shots.scene: 试纸伸进试剂原瓶的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a test strip dipped straight into a reagent stock bottle, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 免得把整瓶试剂弄脏。

shots.scene: 试纸轻轻甩动，旁边一个计时器图标
shots.prompt_en: A test strip being gently shaken with motion lines, next to a timer icon. No people.
shots.narration: 甩掉多余液体，按说明书等待。

shots.section_title: 测有机溶液，别漏加水步骤
shots.scene: 小研对照一份空白说明书检查步骤
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student checks a blank instruction leaflet with numbered pictogram steps.
shots.narration: 测有机溶液，说明书还有一个关键步骤。
overlay: 测有机溶液，别漏加水步骤

shots.section_title: 测有机溶液，别漏加水步骤
shots.scene: 滴管向试纸测试区加一滴水的示意
shots.prompt_en: A simple diagram of a dropper adding one drop of water onto the pad of a test strip. No people.
shots.narration: 按说明书，在测试区加一滴水。

shots.section_title: 测有机溶液，别漏加水步骤
shots.scene: 两条试纸并排，加水后的颜色明显不同
shots.prompt_en: Two test strips side by side: the left pad pale, the right pad clearly darker blue, with an arrow between them. No people.
shots.narration: 漏了这一步，结果就不准。

shots.scene: 水溶液瓶和有机溶液瓶都连到同一组步骤图标
shots.prompt_en: Two bottle icons, one with a water drop symbol and one with a solvent symbol, both linked by arrows to the same row of step icons. No people.
shots.narration: 测水溶液也加这一步，步骤统一。

shots.scene: 小研把试纸贴近罐身的空白比色卡对照
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student holds the test strip next to a color scale of blank blue squares on the canister.
shots.narration: 把测试区和比色卡对照。

shots.scene: 测试区由白变蓝的示意
shots.prompt_en: A simple diagram of a test strip pad changing from white to blue with an arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 测试区变蓝，说明有过氧化物。

shots.scene: 小研在瓶身的空白警示标签上填写
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student writes on a blank blue warning label on the solvent bottle.
shots.narration: 在专用标签上记下检测结果。

shots.scene: 试纸盒上的沙漏图标，过期的试纸盒被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A blank test strip box with an hourglass icon, and an expired box crossed out with a red X next to a new box with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 试纸过期了，换新的再用。

shots.scene: 欣欣指着瓶身空白标签上的警示三角
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at a general warning triangle on the blank label of a brown solvent bottle.
shots.narration: 标签提醒：这类化学品会生成过氧化物。

shots.scene: 棕色瓶盖紧，旁边太阳、空气、火焰图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A tightly capped brown bottle; beside it icons of a sun, an air swirl and a flame, each crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 原瓶盖紧，避光、少接触空气、远离热。

shots.scene: 瓶口结晶、液体浑浊的瓶子图标被打叉，手停住
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a bottle with crystals around the cap and cloudy liquid, and a hand stopping before the cap, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 看到结晶、变色、浑浊，绝不能打开。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在白板前，白板上是瓶子和日历图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at a whiteboard showing a bottle icon and a calendar icon.
shots.narration: 有些溶剂放久了，会慢慢生成过氧化物。

shots.scene: 过氧化物遇热、撞击、摩擦会爆炸的警示图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons — a flame, a hammer and two rubbing surfaces — pointing at a warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 它们遇热、撞击、摩擦可能爆炸。

shots.scene: 蒸馏烧瓶和加热器图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a distillation flask with a heater, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 没检测合格，不能蒸馏或浓缩。

shots.scene: 小研在新到的溶剂瓶空白标签上写日期
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student writes on the blank label of a newly delivered solvent bottle at the bench.
shots.narration: 收到时、开封时，都要写上日期。

shots.scene: 日历图标和检测试纸图标
shots.prompt_en: A calendar icon with a circular arrow next to a test strip icon. No people.
shots.narration: 按学校规程定期检测，按期用完。

shots.scene: 整齐的柜子里只放少量瓶子
shots.prompt_en: A tidy chemical cabinet holding only a few small bottles with blank labels. No people.
shots.narration: 少量采购，不要长期囤放。

shots.section_title: 可疑容器：不开、不动、先报告
shots.scene: 架上一只瓶盖结壳的老旧瓶子，小人后退
shots.prompt_en: An old dusty bottle with a crusty cap sits on a shelf; a person pictogram steps back from it with an arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 老旧、超期、来历不明的瓶子，别打开。
overlay: 可疑容器：不开、不动、先报告

shots.section_title: 可疑容器：不开、不动、先报告
shots.scene: 摇晃瓶子和拧瓶盖的手图标都被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Two icons each crossed out with a red X: a hand shaking a bottle and a hand twisting a bottle cap. No people.
shots.narration: 不摇、不拧、不挪动。

shots.section_title: 可疑容器：不开、不动、先报告
shots.scene: 小研在柜门上贴空白警示牌，关上柜门
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student closes the cabinet door and sticks a blank sign with a general warning triangle on it.
shots.narration: 就地隔离，挂上警示，别让人靠近。

shots.section_title: 可疑容器：不开、不动、先报告
shots.scene: 小研打电话，旁边报告链条图标
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student makes a phone call; beside her float linked icons of a lab room, a department building and a university building.
shots.narration: 报告实验室负责人和学校主管部门。

shots.section_title: 可疑容器：不开、不动、先报告
shots.scene: 保卫处值班员接听电话
shots.prompt_en: The security officer answers a phone call at a duty desk.
shots.narration: 起火拨119，有人受伤拨120。

shots.scene: 检测结果超限的瓶子贴上停用标签
shots.prompt_en: A solvent bottle gets a blank stop-use label with a red cross mark. No people.
shots.narration: 结果超出学校限值，立即停用。

shots.scene: 瓶子放进危险废物收集箱
shots.prompt_en: The bottle is placed into a labelled hazardous waste collection box with a blank label. No people.
shots.narration: 按危险废物交专业单位处置。

shots.scene: 瓶子倒进水槽的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a bottle being poured into a sink, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不得自行处理，更不能倒进下水道。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现通风橱、试纸和比色卡图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a fume hood, a test strip and a color scale.
shots.narration: 通风橱里，按说明书一步不漏。

shots.scene: 标签、日历和签名笔图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a blank label, a calendar and a pen. No people.
shots.narration: 写日期、记结果、定期查。

shots.scene: 结晶瓶子图标和电话图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a bottle with crystals around its cap next to a telephone icon. No people.
shots.narration: 可疑瓶子不打开，马上报告。

shots.scene: 欣欣在整齐的化学品柜前挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye in front of a tidy chemical cabinet with dated blank labels.
shots.narration: 日期写清楚，检测不马虎，下次见！
